svg.title: Serenity UAV build guide 14 - POWER: PDB TO NACELLE ESCs

svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
10 AWG through the fixed spar to the disconnect bay
Flight Engineer PDB, J_ESCn per ESC
40 A mini blade fuse, 1 per ESC
10 AWG silicone, 11.8 in (300 mm) max per
Leg 1: PDB J_ESCn in the fuselage to the wing root.
Leg 2: through the FIXED 20 mm spar bore; the 4-wire bundle twists freely through tilt.
Leg 3: spar bore to the nacelle 10 AWG disconnect bay (pod Z 2.27 in / 57.6 mm).
Leg 4: disconnect bay to each ESC, strain-relieved: ROUTE NOT YET DRAWN (WA-R10).
Close each ESC bay with its own cover (4 distinct).
Before cutting leads, measure the real run from PDB to each ESC, confirm it is within 11.8 in (300 mm), and check that nothing
chafes at the trunnion through the full -5 to 135 deg travel.
SOURCE: FlightEngineer.md; wings-nacelles WBS SPAR-20-1/-2; NACELLE_64MM_VERIFICATION 5
